name: tastesync
description: TasteSync helps college students decide what to eat based on their mood.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.preview: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run start -w server" "npm run preview -w client"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
